player_1.content: New plan: I failed because I treated the task as a simple semantic check (does "mossy" mean "like algae?") and ignored the critical constraint regarding "guess feedback." The instructions stated that feedback indicates which letters *can* be present, and I must "stick to guess feedback." By repeatedly agreeing to "mossy" without verifying if the letters m, o, s, y were validated by previous feedback (or if the feedback actually restricted the word to a specific set of letters), I likely agreed to an invalid guess. Next time, I will strictly cross-reference the letters in the proposed guess against the accumulated guess feedback. If the feedback marks any letter in the guess as "red" (wrong letter) or if the guess contains letters not yet confirmed as valid by the feedback, I will respond with "agreement: no," regardless of whether the word semantically fits the clue. I will only agree if the word fits the clue AND strictly adheres to the letter constraints provided by the feedback.
